versions.changelog:
- Initial release of Mercado Libre category research skill for 极鲸云.
- Enables retrieval of real observed category lists and parent chains from current product samples.
- Supports sales, price range, reputation, and category opportunities research based on actual sampled items.
- Clarifies interface is sample-based and does not represent the full Mercado Libre category market.
- Handles up to 200 product samples per query and explains sample scope and updating.
